# Should We Open A Second Site?

Should Hollowgate Bakehouse open a second café, and specifically take unit 7 at Saltings Market Hall before the option expires on 2026-12-19?

## Why It Matters

It is the largest decision since opening in 2019: a ten-year lease, about 120,000 EUR of fit-out and working capital, an 85,000 EUR loan, and a new production pattern for the bakers. Getting it wrong could put Hollowgate itself back into the overdraft. Not deciding loses unit 7.

## Current Answer

> [!info]
> Not yet. The decision is deferred to 2026-12-15. My working answer is no for unit 7 this winter unless both conditions below move, and yes in principle to a second site once they are met.

Conditions set at the [[second-site-review-2026-09-30]]:

1. A three-month cash buffer of about 95,000 EUR, held before signing ([[how-big-a-cash-buffer-do-we-need]]). In September we held 41,000 EUR.
2. A production plan the bakers accept, with no 03:00 starts ([[can-the-basement-bakery-supply-two-sites]], [[central-production-kitchen]]).

## Options

| Option | For | Against |
|---|---|---|
| Take unit 7 in December with the loan | Keeps the best site we have seen; base case breaks even in month 14 | Buffer below Ruth's rule; low case drags Hollowgate under its floor in January 2028 |
| Extend the option, decide in February 2027 | Christmas cash known; bakers' plan tested | Hall may refuse; fit-out access starts 2027-02-15 |
| Let unit 7 go, build the buffer, look again in 2028 | Safe; no strain on the team | Lose the hall; the Saturday walk-outs continue |
| Grow without a site: wholesale or more Hollowgate hours | Uses spare oven time | Same baker-hours problem ([[why-did-we-pause-wholesale-to-cafes]]) |

## What Would Settle It

- The 2026-11-30 forecast rerun showing the buffer reachable by spring 2027, or not ([[thirteen-week-cash-flow-forecast]]).
- A production pattern proposed by [[kofi-asare]], [[joel-whitcombe]] and [[hana-kobayashi]] that costs out ([[central-production-shift-pattern-options]]).
- Priscilla's answer on extending the option to 2027-02-28.

Evidence: [[saltings-hall-three-scenario-model]], [[pellow-mutual-second-site-loan-offer]], [[a-food-hall-unit-beats-a-standalone-shop]], [[a-second-site-must-not-depend-on-the-overdraft]]. History: [[tanners-row-site]] was dropped on 2026-04-16.

## Owner

Odile. Decision date 2026-12-15.
